summary.text: Lisa Engebretsen is a Republican candidate for the Wyoming State Senate, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A real estate broker, she advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Engebretsen graduated from Kelly Walsh High School and earned an associate degree from Casper College in 1988.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a Wyoming native and the owner of a real estate company that specializes in property management.
She said the issues she works with in that business, including property rights, housing, zoning, taxes and regulations, are the same ones facing the people of Senate District 29.
Engebretsen said her priorities include good-paying jobs, affordable housing, accessible health care and lower taxes, along with protecting private property rights and constitutional freedoms.
